changelog:
Initial release of cashclaw-invoicer.

- Supports invoice creation, payment link generation, payment status tracking, and automated payment reminders via Stripe API.
- Enables multi-currency billing and recurring payments for various services.
- Provides clear step-by-step instructions for using both Stripe SDK (via scripts) and direct Stripe API (curl).
- Details an automated reminder schedule and rules to ensure timely payment follow-ups.
- Tracks all payment and reminder events in a local ledger and updates a dashboard for real-time status.
- Requires Node.js and Stripe API credentials to operate.
